text:
alisa: quick sync  we're seeing inconsistent evict decisions during tenant replay spikes. some shards hard-evict immediately, others issue soft-evict leases and clients hit read-after-evict. want a tiny cross-node "evict-candidate" signal to reduce flapping.

jamal: can you show the minimal proto you have in mind?

alisa: sketch:```
{
  "prefix": "tenant:42:orders",
  "reason": "mem_pressure",
  "score": 0.92,        // 0..1
  "last_seen": 1798888000,
  "kind": "candidate" // candidate|confirm|revoke
}
```lightweight, intended to be piggybacked, not full-blown RPC.

maria: minimal looks good. question: if every node emits candidates we could blow up heartbeat size.

henry: agree. options: (a) include top-k candidates in the regular lease/heartbeat beat, (b) small gossip ring, (c) central aggregator per-shard. piggyback top-k on existing beat seems easiest operationally.

jamal: ok piggyback. correctness worry: two nodes might confirm opposite actions. need deterministic tie-break to avoid chase.

alisa: suggestion: tie-break = lexicographic(node_uuid)+beat_seq. also add a short hysteresis (default 2s) before turning a confirm into a hard-evict so delayed beats can win. keep last_applied_action in ephemeral in-memory map to avoid re-applying.

maria: safety net: if node is about to hard-evict but local read qps > tenant_soft_threshold, downgrade to soft-evict and schedule re-eval. conservative fallback by default.

henry: tradeoff noted: conservative reduces accidental evicts but raises memory. expose tenant-level policy: aggressive|default|conservative so platform can tune.

jamal: test plan: 1) unit tests for tie-break ordering 2) microbench with synthetic hotset across 100 nodes to measure heartbeat growth and false-confirm rate 3) partition/chaos test for split-brain recovery. who picks up the spike?

alisa: i'll spike piggyback approach. instrumentation: evict_candidate_count, confirm_count, delayed_evict_timer, crossnode_conflicts. will publish perf vs memory curve.

ops-bot: <alert>historic sampling recorded ~12k candidate signals/min for a large tenant replay yesterday  filing INC-2026-42 for follow-up</alert>

maria: please include sample heartbeat sizes from the spike so we can set top-k default.

alisa: will do. open question: include an optional small bloom/hash of prefix contents to cheap-validate before confirm? pros: cross-check; cons: cpu and false-negatives.

henry: postpone unless we see many false-confirms. keep v1 tiny. we can add optional field later.

jamal: sounds good. incremental rollout and metrics-driven. thanks alisa :thumbsup:

alisa: thanks  i'll post a short RFC follow-up with spike plan and heartbeat proto.
